L500-L400 best: AbsRel+0.00064103, RMSE-0.00202053, delta1-0.00427379 and F1-0.00361042 have scene CIs crossing zero. Band AbsRel-0.00443093 CI[-0.00690277,-0.00165538] improves. At final, F1-0.01757197 CI[-0.02348563,-0.01168772] worsens while band-0.00306816 CI[-0.00532927,-0.00109752] improves; the three overall-depth metrics cross zero.

L500-R500 matched first-seed best: AbsRel-0.00425664, RMSE-0.01495727, delta1+0.00034980 and F1-0.00011573 all cross zero. Band-0.00817615 CI[-0.01220821,-0.00354528] improves. Final shows the same pattern: only band-0.00936577 has a CI excluding zero.

Against B0, both endpoints improve AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/band with scene CIs excluding zero. F1 best+0.00793818 CI[-0.00127519,0.01792271] and final+0.00049483 cross zero; the shelf example does not establish a general edge-detection gain.

Final-best F1-0.00744335 CI[-0.01051726,-0.00482923] is worse. AbsRel+0.00048809, RMSE-0.00065531, delta1-0.00356410 and band-0.00132716 cross zero. A reduction in metric-depth error near edges can coexist with weaker edge detection.

training_review: Raw best1500, significant-improvement anchor1500, stop2500 after ten stale validations. Best AbsRel0.09069535 rises to final0.09118344 (+0.53816%); post-best maximum0.09226838 at2400. All ten post-best observations are retained.

Stable step is null: the terminal500-step sequence includes values outside1% of raw best (1900/2100/2200/2400). Final being within1% alone does not establish stable convergence. Target0.10 begins100 and confirms300 at168.56215s; target0.09 never qualifies.

Training loss decreases while validation rapidly improves in the first few hundred steps then fluctuates. The recorded late-loss-down/validation-up indicator is false; this is not evidence of monotonic overfitting or stable convergence, and no explosive collapse was observed.

interpretation: L500 first seed improves metric-depth accuracy versus B0 and boundary-band error versus matched R500/L400, but does not establish an overall accuracy increment over L400 or an aggregate edge F1 gain versus B0. Endpoint F1 declines modestly, while fixed samples show both improved structure and adverse value corrections. Wait for the remaining two seeds.
